# POST /api/v1/packages/{owner}/{type}/{name}/-/unlink

Unlink a package from its repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-207`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| type | path | string | True |
| name | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — Package is not linked to any repository
- **403** — User lacks write access or is not owner/org admin
- **404** — Package not found

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [services](../modules/services.md) | context.PackageAssignmentAPI | controller | Resolve user; Determine access mode |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | packages.UnlinkPackage | controller | Get package by name; Call UnlinkFromRepository service |
| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | packages_service.UnlinkFromRepository | service | Validate pkg.RepoID > 0; Get repository by ID; Check doer has write access to TypePackages on repo; Check doer is owner or org admin; Unlink repository |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Package access requires at least read permission; write operations require write access or site admin | authorization | ctx.Package.AccessMode < accessMode && !ctx.IsUserSiteAdmin() |
| UnlinkPackage requires package to be currently linked (RepoID > 0) | validation | pkg.RepoID == 0 |
| UnlinkPackage requires doer to be owner (for user packages) or org admin (for org packages) | authorization | Non-admin user who is not owner or org admin |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Package not found | 404 | notFound | False |
| No write access to repo | 403 | forbidden | False |
| Package not linked (RepoID==0) | 400 | bad request | False |

### Error Paths

- **Package not found** → UnlinkPackage → 404
- **Package not linked (RepoID == 0)** → UnlinkPackage → 400
- **No write permission or not owner/org admin** → UnlinkPackage → 403
